states: Private mock stack built from this branch (PR 2675 head plus this change) with a local-only platform_fixtures overlay pinning TrueNAS disks: nvme0n1 64C, nvme1n1 72C, sda 50C then 60C; factory per-type policy NVMe 70 / SAS 65 / SATA 55
Per-type only (no TrueNAS-wide value, no overrides): nvme1n1 Attention with 'at or above its 70C alert threshold' and amber drawer Temperature; nvme0n1 healthy
Per-disk override nvme1n1 75C saved from the Thresholds page (stored under physical_disk-0ccabe83b84a6c19, the disk's resource id): nvme1n1 healthy in the table, default drawer tone

TrueNAS-wide 62C saved from the TrueNAS Disks Global Defaults row: nvme0n1 Attention 'at or above its 62C alert threshold' and amber drawer tone, nvme1n1 still healthy under its own 75C, sda 60C healthy (62C replaces SATA 55C); backend raised nvme0n1 warning at trigger 62 after the 300s window and nothing for nvme1n1
nvme0n1 muted from its Thresholds row (override disabled): table healthy, drawer default tone, backend alert resolved
TrueNAS-wide Off from the Global Defaults row (trigger 0): no non-override disk hot
truenasDiskDefaults saved with disabled true through the API: no disk hot
Phone width 390: status dot/health and drawer tone follow the same tiers
interactions: Edited the nvme1n1 Temp cell on Alerts > Thresholds > TrueNAS > Disks, blurred to commit, Save Changes
Typed 62 into the Disks Global Defaults Temp cell, Save Changes; later switched it Off with its On control and saved
Switched nvme0n1's per-resource alerts toggle off and saved
Opened /truenas/storage?kind=disks, read each disk row's health attribute and the Attention filter count
Expanded nvme0n1 and nvme1n1 rows, opened Platform details > Show TrueNAS, read the Temperature row tone
Polled /api/alerts/active with a browser client connected to compare the TrueNAS disk temperature alerts
